section: GlowCare Cancellation Policy > Cancellation Window
text:
GlowCare Cancellation Policy > Cancellation Window
Orders can be cancelled free of charge within 2 hours of being placed, as long as the order has not yet entered processing.

section: GlowCare Cancellation Policy > After Processing Has Started
text:
GlowCare Cancellation Policy > After Processing Has Started
Once an order has entered processing (typically after the 2-hour window), it cannot be cancelled through self-service. Customers must contact support, who will attempt to stop the shipment if possible. If the order has already shipped, it cannot be cancelled and the customer should use the Return Policy instead once it arrives.

section: GlowCare Cancellation Policy > How to Cancel
text:
GlowCare Cancellation Policy > How to Cancel
Customers can request cancellation by providing their order number to support. Support will confirm whether cancellation is still possible based on order status.

section: GlowCare Cancellation Policy > Refunds for Cancelled Orders
text:
GlowCare Cancellation Policy > Refunds for Cancelled Orders
If a cancellation is successful before shipment, a full refund is issued automatically to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

section: GlowCare Customer Support Policy > Support Channels
text:
GlowCare Customer Support Policy > Support Channels
Support is available through the GlowCare chat assistant and, for escalated cases, a human support team.

section: GlowCare Customer Support Policy > What the AI Assistant Can Help With
text:
GlowCare Customer Support Policy > What the AI Assistant Can Help With
- Product questions, ingredients, and usage guidance
- Product recommendations based on skin type/concern
- Pricing and availability
- Shipping, return, refund, and cancellation policy questions
- Order status lookups

section: GlowCare Customer Support Policy > When a Case Is Escalated to a Human
text:
GlowCare Customer Support Policy > When a Case Is Escalated to a Human
- The customer explicitly asks to speak to a human
- A complaint or complex issue the assistant cannot resolve
- A safety-related concern (e.g. suspected adverse reaction to a product)
- A situation where required information is unavailable or the assistant is not confident in the answer

section: GlowCare Customer Support Policy > Response Expectations
text:
GlowCare Customer Support Policy > Response Expectations
The AI assistant responds instantly. Escalated human support cases are typically responded to within 1 business day in this demo scenario.

section: GlowCare Customer Support Policy > What the AI Assistant Will Not Do
text:
GlowCare Customer Support Policy > What the AI Assistant Will Not Do
- Diagnose medical or dermatological conditions
- Claim a product treats, cures, or prevents any medical condition
- Guess at information it cannot verify from official sources (product data, order data, or policy documents)

section: GlowCare Ingredients Guide > Overview
text:
GlowCare Ingredients Guide > Overview
This guide explains, in plain language, the role of key ingredients used across GlowCare products. This is general cosmetic-ingredient information, not medical advice.

**Hyaluronic Acid** — A humectant that helps draw and hold moisture in the skin, contributing to a plumper, hydrated appearance.

**Niacinamide** — A form of vitamin B3 commonly used to help with the appearance of pores, uneven texture, and oil balance.

**Ceramides** — Lipids naturally found in skin that help support the skin's barrier function, reducing moisture loss.

**Zinc PCA** — Often used alongside niacinamide to help regulate excess oil production.

**Glycerin** — A widely used humectant that helps attract water to the skin's surface.

section: GlowCare Ingredients Guide > Overview
text:
GlowCare Ingredients Guide > Overview
**Dimethicone** — A silicone-based ingredient that gives products a smooth, lightweight feel and can help reduce moisture loss.

**Zinc Oxide / Titanium Dioxide** — Mineral UV filters used in sunscreens to help protect skin from UVA/UVB rays.

**Panthenol** — A form of provitamin B5 used to help soothe and moisturize skin.

**Allantoin** — An ingredient known for its soothing, skin-conditioning properties.

section: GlowCare Ingredients Guide > Important Note
text:
GlowCare Ingredients Guide > Important Note
This guide describes general ingredient functions and does not make claims that any GlowCare product treats, cures, or prevents any medical or dermatological condition. Customers with known allergies or sensitivities should review full ingredient lists and consult a dermatologist if uncertain.

section: GlowCare Product Guide > Hydra Balance Moisturizer
text:
GlowCare Product Guide > Hydra Balance Moisturizer
A lightweight, oil-free daily moisturizer built around hyaluronic acid and niacinamide. Designed for oily, combination, and normal skin types that want hydration without a heavy or greasy feel. Absorbs quickly, layers well under sunscreen or makeup.

section: GlowCare Product Guide > Barrier Repair Cream
text:
GlowCare Product Guide > Barrier Repair Cream
A rich, ceramide-based cream for dry, sensitive, or compromised skin. Formulated to help restore the skin's natural moisture barrier using a blend of ceramides, cholesterol, fatty acids, and shea butter. Best used at night, can be layered over serums for extra nourishment.

section: GlowCare Product Guide > Niacinamide Serum
text:
GlowCare Product Guide > Niacinamide Serum
A 10% niacinamide serum targeting visible pores, uneven texture, and excess oil. Suited to oily and combination skin. New users are advised to introduce it gradually (every other day) to assess tolerance.

section: GlowCare Product Guide > Gentle Daily Cleanser
text:
GlowCare Product Guide > Gentle Daily Cleanser
A sulfate-free, low-pH cleanser suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. Designed to remove impurities without stripping the skin's natural moisture.

section: GlowCare Product Guide > Lightweight Sunscreen SPF 50
text:
GlowCare Product Guide > Lightweight Sunscreen SPF 50
A broad-spectrum mineral sunscreen (zinc oxide and titanium dioxide based) with a light, non-greasy finish. Suitable for daily wear across all skin types, including oily and sensitive skin.

section: GlowCare Product Guide > General Routine Guidance
text:
GlowCare Product Guide > General Routine Guidance
A simple starting routine: Cleanser → (optional Serum) → Moisturizer → Sunscreen (AM), and Cleanser → (optional Serum) → Moisturizer (PM). This is general guidance only, not a personalized medical or dermatological recommendation.

section: GlowCare Refund Policy > Eligibility
text:
GlowCare Refund Policy > Eligibility
Refunds are issued once a valid return is received and inspected, or when GlowCare confirms an order will not be fulfilled (e.g. item permanently out of stock after payment).

section: GlowCare Refund Policy > Refund Method
text:
GlowCare Refund Policy > Refund Method
Refunds are issued to the original payment method used at checkout. GlowCare does not issue cash refunds.

section: GlowCare Refund Policy > Refund Timing
text:
GlowCare Refund Policy > Refund Timing
Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after approval. It may take an additional 3-5 business days for the refund to appear on the customer's statement, depending on their bank or card issuer.

section: GlowCare Refund Policy > Partial Refunds
text:
GlowCare Refund Policy > Partial Refunds
If only part of an order is returned, a partial refund is issued for the returned item(s) only. Shipping fees are non-refundable unless the return is due to a GlowCare error (wrong item sent, defective product).

section: GlowCare Refund Policy > Denied Refunds
text:
GlowCare Refund Policy > Denied Refunds
Refunds may be denied if the return does not meet the conditions in the Return Policy (e.g. opened product without a valid reason, missing proof of purchase, past the 30-day window).

section: GlowCare Return Policy > Return Window
text:
GlowCare Return Policy > Return Window
Products may be returned within 30 days of delivery.

section: GlowCare Return Policy > Condition for Returns
text:
GlowCare Return Policy > Condition for Returns
- Unopened products in original packaging: eligible for full return.
- Opened or used products: eligible for return ONLY if the customer experienced an adverse reaction or the product arrived damaged/defective. In these cases, contact support with details before returning.
- Products without proof of purchase (order number or receipt) cannot be returned.

section: GlowCare Return Policy > Non-Returnable Items
text:
GlowCare Return Policy > Non-Returnable Items
Sale/clearance items marked "final sale" at time of purchase are not eligible for return.

section: GlowCare Return Policy > How to Start a Return
text:
GlowCare Return Policy > How to Start a Return
Customers should contact support with their order number and reason for return. Support will issue a return authorization and instructions.

section: GlowCare Return Policy > Refund Timing
text:
GlowCare Return Policy > Refund Timing
Once a return is received and inspected, refunds are processed within 5-7 business days to the original payment method.

section: GlowCare Shipping Policy > Processing Time
text:
GlowCare Shipping Policy > Processing Time
Orders are processed within 1-2 business days after payment confirmation. Orders placed on weekends or public holidays are processed on the next business day.

section: GlowCare Shipping Policy > Shipping Methods and Timeframes
text:
GlowCare Shipping Policy > Shipping Methods and Timeframes
- Standard Shipping: 3-5 business days, $4.99, free on orders over $50.
- Express Shipping: 1-2 business days, $12.99.

section: GlowCare Shipping Policy > Order Tracking
text:
GlowCare Shipping Policy > Order Tracking
Once an order ships, the customer receives a tracking number by email. Tracking status can also be checked by providing the order number to support.

section: GlowCare Shipping Policy > Shipping Destinations
text:
GlowCare Shipping Policy > Shipping Destinations
GlowCare currently ships within the country of operation only for this demo. International shipping is not available in this demo version.

section: GlowCare Shipping Policy > Delays
text:
GlowCare Shipping Policy > Delays
Delays may occur during high-demand periods (e.g. holiday sales) or due to courier issues outside GlowCare's control. Customers will be notified by email if a significant delay occurs.
